citations.purpose: dataset-hash: The policy is stated in-source: a model may be evaluated on a dataset whose DatasetSha256 differs from the one recorded at training, so dataset bytes are not a binding constraint — only inputs, simulator hash, spec, perspective and choice policy are.

unresolved: TrainingAdmission (VerifyDataset, Check, Hash, Json) and QualityReport are not in the permitted read set, so the exact contents of quality.InputsSha256 beyond the *.json enumeration plus the two dll keys, how GateVersion is assigned, and whether VerifyDataset recomputes DataSha256 from the .bin bytes could not be confirmed here.

NnModel.Load/NormalizeInto/ForwardLogitNormalized/MetaJson, StateEncoder (Spec, Dim, OffGlobal, TurnScale), EpisodeSampling and GreedyEpisodeRunner are outside the read set; Verify's model-side determinism and the exact meaning of the encoder spec string cannot be checked from these two files.

Program.cs Verify never calls ValueTrainingContract.RequireRuntime, so within these sources no evaluation-time check ties a model to the running engine binary; whether another component enforces that is not determinable from the read scope, and no intent is inferred from the omission.

Verify recomputes the val/train partition from --split-seed instead of using the persisted validationGameIds/trainingGameIds, so a split-seed mismatch would go undetected by these two files and would silently evaluate a different validation set; no guard exists in the read scope.

The default splitSeed = -1 routes both Train and Verify through Random.Shared, which the source states is not reproducible; exact split reconstruction therefore holds only when the same explicit --split-seed is supplied to both commands, and this was not executed or tested (no build or run was performed).

The dataset-hash exception comment (ValueTrainingContract.cs line 83) and the absence of any DatasetSha256 comparison are recorded as source facts only; whether that is the intended policy or a gap is not decided here and no certification of training or rules is proposed.
